outcome: Editing a context doc no longer reds CI: any git commit through an agent session (either runtime) re-scans docs/context in-process, auto-stages the refreshed ledger.json so the diff rides that same commit, and blocks the commit with the reason while a secret-shaped or oversized context file is unfixed. The write-time hook is deferred with a recorded trigger (D-0015); decision 0035 captures the belt contract.
